maximum_depth_rule: All 35 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once. The 35 reviewed rows in the complete plan and 33 reviewed rows in the action-plan extract overlap and must not be added into 68 canonical records.
version_boundary: The December 2025 approved plan, its long-term vision, and the fiscal 2026 to 2030 action plan remain separate hierarchy and period layers. First-year evaluation is unpublished and is not inferred from plan values.
non_goals: Do not add overlapping reviewed rows from the complete plan and action-plan extract.
Do not infer records for the four registered documents with zero reviewed rows.
Do not split mixed baseline, current, 2030, and 2040 values into inferred actual and target fields.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
